A procession of armored soldiers in dark blue-grey armor walks away from the camera along the path, spaced apart in loose formation, each carrying a spear, their figures small against the monumental architecture. Warm yellow light glows from a few lanterns mounted at intervals along the right wall. The atmosphere is cold, hazy, and misty, with pale blue fog drifting between the buildings and soft snowfall settling on rooftops and shoulders.
